meta.grade_scale: xfv_grade is THE board number: the displayed grade, the sort key and the basis of overall_rank (storage.BOARD_GRADE_FIELD). Since 2026-09-25 (DS-02) it is eFV V2 on every row with grade_basis efv_v2: the consensus FV value of the prospect's (side, list year) group at the rank of V2's order index (efv_v2.order_idx, also the board_sort_key), so consensus sets the level and the model only reorders. The same grade prices surplus_mm, the band and dist (xfv_grade_quantile equals it on these rows) and keys the odds: p_bucket and p_bust are the consensus outcome table read at this grade (xfv_grade_odds). xfv_war_6yr is the consensus-FV-to-six-season-WAR line at the grade, context only. Rows with grade_basis provisional_capped have no source grade and are served by the production-only provisional model. Graduates and busts (kind debuted / bust) keep eFV v1.

claim.text: Ties PROSPX consensus: Spearman difference -0.0049, CI95 -0.021 to +0.011 on the vintage-matched, timing-pinned frame (n 829, 2026-10-02).

pit.consensus_only_reason: owner DS-Q2: no pitcher skill driver passed the admission rule in this fold, so pitchers take the consensus order

served_model.who: every active prospect with a real consensus grade; rows whose consensus is the last-resort constant are served by the production-only provisional model (grade_basis provisional_capped)

serve_vs_eval_census.what_this_is: xfv_grade is the SERVED board number (storage.BOARD_GRADE_FIELD): the displayed grade, the sort key and the basis of overall_rank. xfv_war_6yr is the model leg the eval scores. rank_war is the guarded blend. This counts how far apart those orderings run, per side, on pairs untied on both coordinates, and splits the grade map by routing basis. It reads xfv_grade and NOT xfv_grade_quantile, which is the retired map kept to price surplus and which reports a completely different picture.
serve_vs_eval_census.what_it_measured_when_written: Flagship map exactly monotone: 0 inversions over 879,105 untied pairs across both sides. Provisional cap inverts against the model's own predicted WAR on 25.4% of hitter and 49.2% of pitcher untied pairs, and is served to 51% and 58% of the live board. Half is what independence looks like. A player with no professional record is graded off a prior by design, so this is the design, not a defect.
serve_vs_eval_census.read_a_flat_column_correctly: Inversions catch a map that REORDERS the model and say nothing about one that FLATTENS it, so read distinct_displayed_grades and modal_share beside inverted_share before calling a low count a clean result.
serve_vs_eval_census.why_it_is_published: It bounds what a head-to-head on this artifact covers. Where the served grade carries little information about the model's own prediction, a rank claim over the whole board is really a claim about the rows where it does.
